notes:
Phase 5: Lexicon 第二大脑与轻量 User Profile 智能归纳系统正式上线
1. 新增：SQLite 个人资产表 (user_word_memory) 与 localStorage 双向持久化，永久沉淀个人笔记、AI 追问 Q&A 历史及 Core 核心意象。
2. 新增：Gemini 2.0 Flash 高上下文 Profile 智能归纳引擎，支持 8K-15K Tokens 高上下文全量蒸馏与“增/改/剪枝”智能 Upsert 算法。
3. 新增：个人弱项看板 (AILearningDigestCard) 置于空白页，实时呈现 Active 认知薄弱点与 Mode 3 Core 概念导引。
4. 新增：LexiconMemoryBadge 词汇资产标识与结果页末尾 UserNoteEditor 笔记/Q&A 沉淀编辑器。
5. 优化：修复 Android 原生 SQLite 初始化，提升 Android WebView 多层级数据兼容性与内存防溢流保护。

notes_en:
Phase 5: Lexicon Memory & Intelligent User Profile Engine Release
1. New: SQLite Personal Memory Table (user_word_memory) with automatic localStorage backup for persisting user notes, AI Q&A history, and Core concepts.
2. New: High-Context Profile Induction Engine for Gemini 2.0 Flash (8K-15K Tokens context) with Intelligent Upsert (Add/Modify/Prune) logic.
3. New: AI Learning Digest Dashboard (AILearningDigestCard) on empty search view displaying active mental gaps and Mode 3 Core recommendations.
4. New: LexiconMemoryBadge status indicators and integrated UserNoteEditor at the bottom of result views.
5. Optimization: Fixed native Android SQLite schema initialization and expanded 20K Token buffer protection per word record.
